notes.title: "Empire Origin:Rise" game background introduction
notes.content:
[h2]After the game is launched, it supports 3 languages: English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese[/h2]

In the background of the story, after the natural catastrophe, a small number of human beings survived through the survival plan in the center of the earth. The former empire is no longer, and human civilization has suffered a serious fault.

In order to retrieve the lost civilization of the empire, humans in the center of the earth produced a technological crystallization called the astrolabe. The astrolabe can evolve the past time and space on the civilization relics, collect the information of the lost civilization, and build a shared virtual civilized world.

In this world, a group of revivalists of the imperial civilization collect the information of the imperial civilization through the astrolabe and enter the virtual shared world. With a passion for the origin of the empire's culture, they joined hands to find the origin of the empire and strengthen the civilization of the empire, embodying the spirit of pursuing ancient history and cultural revival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44268492/ef64aa6902cc1fd60743a574eed35c9c52540889.png[/img]
The gameplay of the game is mainly based on exploration, development and expansion. The character played by the player needs to develop the territory in the sandbox world, recruit heroes, collect resources, and develop the recruited heroes. Cooperate with multiple players, pass through the difficult gates, rebuild the imperial civilization step by step in the virtual world, trace the origin of civilization, and seek the recovery of culture.

This game takes the sand table world as the core, and builds an overhead continent with 2.25 million grid fragments. The continent contains sand, grass, jungle, scorched earth, snow and other landforms of mountains, rivers and rivers. There are more than 80 original paintings of heroes in the game. Each hero is equipped with an independent hero story, dedicated to restoring a real and dynamically developing world.

The passage of time can never stop the progress of human civilization and society. Human beings are moving towards scientific progress and the evolution of a natural and harmonious living environment, so that human beings can live happier and better on the earth! This core concept runs throughout the game, tracing the development trajectory of predecessors and absorbing the life wisdom of predecessors. Players can learn about the epitome of many historical stories and spiritual and cultural connotations through the game. This game is based on the sand table world as the core gameplay. In the process of exploring the world, it can broaden the player's horizon. The design of some special terrain can increase the fun of the player and cultivate the player's strategic thinking.
